skill_name: Explain why the Stock Market crashed in 1929.
workflow: The Stock Market crash of 1929 was caused by a combination of economic and political factors. On the political side, there were a number of events leading up to the crash, including the passage of the Smoot-Hawley Tariff, which raised tariffs on imported goods and caused significant harm to international trade.
